overall_comment: A structurally excellent outline: boundaries mirror the conversation's task arc including the PyMuPDF detour and explicit return, and every summary sentence checks out against the transcript with 25/26 spans genuinely supporting their claims. Weaknesses concentrate in the annotation layer rather than the narrative: salient detection catches 7 of ~14 hard constraints but misses the VAT-rate domain rule and the AGPL prohibition — the two constraints most likely to matter downstream — and the char-limited titles degrade into mid-word truncation twice. Dense single-sentence summaries for 10-12-turn units also flatten real events like the two test-failure bug fixes.
